interpretations: Keep films with replacement_cost > 20.99 (strictly greater), group by film.rating, and return rating, AVG(length), and AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration), where the ratio is computed per film and then averaged, with no rounding.
Same as 1, but "more than 20.99" is read inclusively (replacement_cost >= 20.99).
Same as 1, but the second metric is the ratio of group averages, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration), rather than the average of per-film ratios.
Same as 1, but the second metric is the ratio of group totals, SUM(rental_rate) / SUM(rental_duration).

Same as 1, but AVG(length) uses only films where length is non-null, and the ratio average uses only films where both rental_rate and rental_duration are non-null. Each metric ignores NULLs independently.
Same as 1, but a film is dropped from both metrics if length, rental_rate or rental_duration is NULL, so both averages are computed over the same set of films.
Same as 1, but each film is weighted by its number of inventory copies (joining inventory), so the averages are per copy rather than per film.
Same as 1, but ratings with no qualifying films are also listed, with NULL averages (rating taken from all films).
Same as 1, but output columns are named explicitly, such as rating, avg_length and avg_rental_rate_per_day, ordered by rating.
Same as 1, but the replacement_cost threshold is applied after grouping (for example, groups whose average or maximum replacement_cost exceeds 20.99) instead of to individual films.
queries: SELECT rating, AVG(length), AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) FROM film GROUP BY rating;

SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
FROM film
GROUP BY rating

SELECT rental_duration, AVG(length), AVG(rental_rate)
FROM film
WHERE length IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rental_duration
